name: When do I need professional water damage restoration services?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional water damage restoration services?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact professional water damage restoration services immediately if you experience significant water intrusion, such as from a burst pipe, flood, or sewage backup. Professionals have specialized equipment for thorough water extraction, drying, and moisture detection, which prevents secondary damage like mold growth and structural weakening. Even seemingly minor leaks can lead to hidden damage if not addressed promptly and properly, making professional assessment vital.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact professionals for significant water intrusion like floods or burst pipes. They have specialized equipment to prevent mold and structural damage, even from minor leaks.
